title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I'm sorry, but the pen scratching you hear is just me engaging in shorthanding... to put it another way, I'm helping myself to think. I'm busy with Joint Marine Corps affairs, so I'm afraid I can't help you tackle your paperwork.

title: Talk 1
original: It's been difficult explaining how my launcher works to the Sankta operators, and when I asked them about their guns, their eccentric answers only confused me more. Hm? I shouldn't lose heart? You're overthinking it, how could I be discouraged from just that? The reason I'm here is precisely for the sea and land to understand each other.

title: Talk 2
original: Coffee, tea, cocoa... These land stimulants have a novel taste to them. They're not very effective, but it's fine. This way I get to try many types of them. How many cups have I had today? This is number eight. The Seaborn swarm is still on the move, and HQ may reach out at any time, so I have to stay alert.

title: Talk 3
original: Doctor, there's no fresh information from Ægir on this sketch board. These wavy lines and small squares are just my thought process. As for what they mean exactly, it's very hard to explain. Hm? If this part means 'signal strength'? You... can read it?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Unfortunately, I didn't manage to become an Abyssal Hunter, but that's not the only way Ægir fights the Seaborn. We have the Hunters, the Waterway—and many more in the future. My current position dictates I no longer be affiliated with any projects, but that does not imply my duties are lighter, even in the slightest.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Our nation is not a machine, but an organic system. The gears do not spin on their own, yet every single cell, even if it loses the system's protection, will fight to the end for the organism's survival... This is what I defend and firmly believe in, nothing more.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Irene invited me to a ball last time, but I'm unfamiliar with the way land dwellers dance. I thought a direct refusal would be rude, so I didn't answer at all. Yet, it seemed to make her even more disappointed... Um? I can dance however I want? Then I'll join them next time. I may shoulder heavy responsibilities, but there's no harm in engaging in appropriate and beneficial recreation.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Drop the act, I know who was just in here. As long as you're not the one he's contacting—no, even if it is you— Nah, forget it, I've already neglected my duties by not reporting him immediately, not to mention our current situation. Anyway, I'd like you to tell him this for me—he may be a genius, but he is a terrible mess as a teacher.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: The Abyssal Hunters have returned, surprisingly, and the Waterway has been opened somehow. Those are certainly not what I expected as watchman, but they are gratifying enough. Doctor, I stand here now watching over you as well, and look forward to seeing how you'll transform this war.

title: Idle
original: Doctor, contacts from Ægir will be here anytime. If you're not awake by then, I will inject you with a nerve activating solution. Oh, I will try to wake you up first.

title: Onboard
original: Dr. {@nickname}, I'm glad to meet you on land. We're fighting the same war, and that is why I stand before you now.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I'm adapting myself to land-based warfare and combat styles.

title: Promotion 1
original: I'm grateful for your recognition. The promotion ceremony has ended, right? Perfect, I have some new Joint Marine documents to look through together.

title: Promotion 2
original: Praise in a perilous time often means even heavier responsibilities. I'm prepared, Doctor.

title: Added to Squad
original: I'll intercept the tides. It is Ægir's duty to keep them off the land.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I'll synchronize everyone with our battle plans promptly. If there's anything you find hard to understand, don't worry. Ægir guarantees your lives are the paramount priority.

title: Depart
original: Our fleet is in position. I'll guide us to our designated spot.

title: Begin Operation
original: Hmph. Detritus.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Toxic finspine launcher, ready to fire.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I'm in position.

title: Deployment 1
original: Please gather behind my shield.

title: Deployment 2
original: The air is so dry... no, it's nothing.

title: In Battle 1
original: Don't misunderstand, you're not even threats to me.

title: In Battle 2
original: Be glad you're only facing the Sea Patrol, not our regular army.

title: In Battle 3
original: Did you just beg for mercy? Couldn't hear you over all that shelling.

title: In Battle 4
original: Requesting more firepower—Gah, I'll do it myself.

title: 4-star Result
original: Your results surpassed my expectations, even in such difficult circumstances. Do you have time to tell me what was on your mind? There are some parts of your plan I still don't understand...

title: 3-star Result
original: An exemplary show of command.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: This result... isn't entirely unacceptable. Only, the enemies we let go, may not necessarily let us go in turn.

title: Operation Failure
original: I take it you're just having a bad day, but our enemies hope you stay like that for good. You need to pull yourself together.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I still have Sea Patrol work to deal with, so I can't always be at Rhodes Island. If you need anything from me, raise a request and I'll get to it promptly.

title: Tap
original: Casual chats aren't my strong suit. Find someone else to talk to.

title: Trust Tap
original: If you really want to know how I think while writing shorthand, I can explain it to you.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: You people flip through this printed product every day or month, treat it with great importance, and even celebrate when you switch it out for another... Can I have a look? Oh... it's called 'paper calendar'? Hmm... so land dwellers celebrate the first day of every year. I will record this in my cultural exchange notes.

title: Greeting
original: Reporting in, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, for you. Wait, why are you using it as a coaster? Doctor, they're not shorthand scribbles, I wrote an earnest birthday message, so I'd appreciate it if you would actually read it.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I had lots of worries before I came ashore. My concerns have been validated, yet I feel even more confident. Why? Because I see a universal tenacity shared by land and sea. You face Catastrophes as Ægir fights the Seaborn—we will never surrender.
